conclusion: No functional blocker found in the frozen adapter for its stated new-V3-store and cooperating-local-store scope. The parent README correctly warns that legacy V1 stores/plans are not migrated; the V3 README also states pins do not prove plan creator identity and its synthetic mechanics are not scientific evidence. Do not interpret queue accepted_execution as forecast qualification or model selection.

findings.evidence: V3 compiler imports queue modules with queue-v3 directory at sys.path[0], pins its compiler/queue/executor/ledger/receipt decoder and pins parent scoped_selection/native_selection/helper modules. The queue current_sources contract binds an initialized V3 store to its dispatcher/executor sources. The regression test confirms V1 dispatcher refuses a V3 store and retry/resume compilers reject plans missing the V3 experiment_queue.py dispatcher-source pin.
findings.limit: Pins establish byte identity at verification time under the documented cooperating local-store model; they are not authenticated authorship and do not protect against arbitrary concurrent hostile mutations.

findings.evidence: Build emits one fixed preparation/application job; preparation carries no application authority. Application recipe checks exact task/candidate/native spec/revision/predecessor/journal cycle, while actual native and journal admission stays in unchanged scoped_selection CLI. Retry copies the exact spec and only changes attempt/output/queue/predecessor/reason; resume requires sealed never-launched evidence and queue enqueue performs stronger same-store reference, launch-intent, process/claim and exact-spec/output checks.
findings.limit: Compiler checks are deliberately not sufficient admission. Decision/current journal validity, process state, competing references and exact owner output freshness rely on the existing CLI/dispatcher/executor at execution/enqueue time.

findings.evidence: All seven tests passed. Tests exercise actual queued CLI subprocesses and a post-COMMIT/pre-receipt failure followed by a fresh explicit attempt that observes already_applied without duplicate event. The test explicitly demonstrates source-drift deferral/resumption, then a terminal retry that sheds consumed prelaunch evidence.
findings.limit: All sources, registry and native inspection fixtures are invented temporary test data; synthetic interpreter monkeypatches native inspector. The deterministic drift test patches launch in-process. No adversarial hostile-history, power-loss, true concurrent mutation, or real scientific selection was tested.

findings.evidence: The reviewed queue-v3/selection_queue.md contains no “six cases” phrase or case count. The earlier review incorrectly attributed that statement to this document; no documentation change is warranted. The test file has seven methods and all passed.
findings.recommendation: Retract the prior count discrepancy; preserve the reviewed document.

independent_test.effects: Tests use temporary invented native fixtures and queue stores; test code invokes actual compiler/dispatcher/worker/selection CLI subprocesses. The synthetic executable substitutes fake native inspection only. One drift hook patches execution.launch to deterministically inject prelaunch source drift.
